item.title: Red Book I #4
item.description: China, 2010. Flights are immediately diverted into and out of Xiaoshan Airport as staff and passengers aboard multiple planes report seeing flashes and beams of otherworldly light. item.title: The History of Metroidvania: Decade One--1980-1990 HC
